# Onboarding

Read these before your first word:

- Your goal and your weekly report, in the [team deck](https://example.com/deck): [slide 18](https://example.com/deck#slide=18) and `reports/onboarding.md`.
- Your mock folder, `mocks/onboarding/`, holds the approved screens.
